# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework, phase 1 (route C): province statuses. Generated by gen_territory_status.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Theme country scope. A theme with no status gets one from its subject type.
oe_ts_init_status = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_status } }
        if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_status value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_latin } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_status value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_status value = 4 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_status value = 1 } }
        ruler ?= { reset_ruler_title = {} }  # third round T4: the title was computed before the status existed
    }
}

# Theme country scope. Keeps exactly one status modifier, the one of the current status.
oe_ts_apply_status = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_core } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_charter remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_despot add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ts_status_core years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 2 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_core remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_charter remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_despot add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_core remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_charter remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_despot add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 4 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_charter } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_core remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_despot add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ts_status_charter years = -1 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 5 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_despot } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_core remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_frontier remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_exarch remove_country_modifier = oe_ts_status_charter add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ts_status_despot years = -1 mode = replace } }
}

# Theme country scope. The one way to change a status: oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 }. The modifier follows at once;
# the rank name and ruler title follow by themselves (country_flavor reads the variable); the country name is refreshed.
oe_ts_set_status = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_status value = $status$ }
    oe_ts_apply_status = yes
    ruler ?= { reset_ruler_title = {} }  # third round T4: 将军 / 督军 / 总督 / 专制公 follow the status at once
    oe_theme_refresh_name = yes  # gen_theme_names.py: 行省 / 总督区 / 专制公国 name variants
}

# Theme country scope, monthly. Exarchates and despotates send their share of the monthly income to the treasury,
# with the senate's extra levy, when the province can pay it in full.
oe_ts_tribute = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ts_trib value = oe_ts_tribute_amount }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ts_trib > 0 gold >= scope:oe_ts_trib }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_ts_trib multiply = -1 }
        c:BYZ = { add_gold = scope:oe_ts_trib }
    }
}
